title: 5 Centavos (Patria o Muerte)

obverse.description: Cuban coat of arms, country name as curved legend on top, face value in letters as curved legend on bottom, line of denticles close to rim.

reverse.description: Face value in Roman numeral in circle over a five-pointed star, motto "Fatherland or Death" as curved legend on top, date on exergue, line of denticles close to rim.

comments:
This coin was split from KM# 34 (see link) cause the change of legend is considered a major variation.

On 2016 legend was changed from "PATRIA Y LIBERTAD" to "PATRIA O MUERTE", this legend have been changed on 1 and 2 centavos coins on 1983, and on 20 and 40 centavos on 1982, but remained unchanged on 5 centavos value. 2016 coins are not still listed on Krause.
1 cent coins had the same variation and kept same KM#, as variant; therefore, is possible when Krause list this coin be catalogued (relisted) as KM# 34.1 up to 2015, and added as KM# 34.2 from 2016 and on.

UPDATE: For a new "PATRIA O MUERTE" modification the left point of the star points on the left leg of the A


(source: picture taken by Pksaha)

Known variations on year issues:
2017: Thick slightly larger date


(Images courtesy of steffffffan)

UPDATE: On website Numismaster, issues this coin dated 2016 & 2017 were recently listed together with KM# 34. Considering change of legend is a major variation, we assume they did not notice the difference, and only added the new dates. There is not a picture of the coin, and only a drawing of the 1968 issue.
